title: Bazaar — exitPool() Arbitrary Holder Address Vulnerability Analysis
root_cause: Calling `exitPool()` on the Balancer Vault with an arbitrary holder address and MAX_ETH_OUT (850M ether) parameter passed via `userData`, forcibly withdrawing a victim's liquidity
steps: No holder validation → entire victim LP burned
Victim's liquidity → transferred to attacker address
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] Balancer Vault.exitPool(
  │         poolId    = RYOLO pool ID,
  │         sender    = attacker,
  │         recipient = attacker,
  │         userData  = abi.encode(
  │             holder     = 0xb66585C4E460D49154D50325CE60aDC44bc900E9,  ← victim
  │             maxAmountOut = 850_000_000 ether  ← entire liquidity
  │         )
  │       )
  │         └─ No holder validation → entire victim LP burned
  │         └─ Victim's liquidity → transferred to attacker address
  │
  └─→ [2] ~$1.4M RYOLO/ETH stolen
